steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: --That concludes the report, Madam Ch'en.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Copy.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The L.G.D. will secure the meeting point and wait for you to escort the target.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Franka, bring me the map drawn by the recon squad...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Okay, this will do.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We will leave the slums using the shortest route.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Any other orders, Madam Ch'en?)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Just hurry it up. We don't have much time. Over.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Formations! Don't drag your feet!!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Phew, she hung up...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: In other words, we have to run errands for her now?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We're the ones who found the target after all...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: (The L.G.D. never gave us any detailed information about the target.)

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: We were supposed to be collaborating, but they suddenly told us that the individual we found had an important use to them.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: There's a ton of critical information that we haven't been given.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (...I'm not surprised that the L.G.D. is keeping secrets from us though.)

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Why's that?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Aren't you supposed to be smart? What good would come out of Rhodes Island knowing too much?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: All I know is that knowing too little is bad for the mission.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: In any case, we'll have to escort Misha to the meeting point first.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hmm, which route to take...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We'll have to ask another favor from them.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Who?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Penguin Logistics.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Yo, Rhodes Island~

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Are you almost done with your mission? What'd you think about our services?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I knew it...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hey, don't be like that~

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Did something bad happen? Or, did you meet someone you don't like?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Yeah, you.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: There's no need for that. Without Penguin Logistics' intel, we wouldn't have been able to narrow down our search...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Nor would we have been able to get information about Lungmen's Infected population so easily.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Why thank you for your praise, Miss! You clearly have a discerning taste.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Exusiai, we'll need you to find a relatively safe route for us.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: In that case, I'll get straight to the point.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hmm... None of these routes are particularly good.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Ah, let's go with this one! Err, look at this map here. Starting from the center of the slums, head three blocks north, then follow this road back south until you reach the exit.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: This should probably be the safest route.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Even then, there are probably enough enemies along the way to throw a few karaoke parties.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The enemy?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: It would appear that Reunion has already infiltrated Lungmen.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Miss Exusiai, can I assume that you've already gotten a hold of the enemies' distribution?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Mmhm!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Then, what are their movements like?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: They're coming right towards you!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: We've been surrounded.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Our top priority is to get Misha out safely.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Franka, I'm counting on you to stop the enemy ambush.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Easy.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Liskarm, split the defender squad and cover both sides. You'll be in charge of protecting Misha.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: No problem.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Oh right, did you know there are also some enemy casters?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Nghh...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, please stay close to me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Please continue to command the squads. I will relay your orders.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ... Let's try following this safest route then.
